- pr-review-toolkit:code-reviewer: Use this agent when you need to review code for adherence to project guidelines, style guides, and best practices. It will check for style violations, potential issues, and ensure code follows the established patterns in CLAUDE.md. Also the agent needs to know which files to focus on for the review. In most cases this will be recently completed work which is unstaged in git (can be retrieved by running git diff). Typical triggers include the user asking for a review of a feature they just implemented, the assistant proactively reviewing its own newly-written code before declaring a task done, and a final pre-PR check before opening a pull request. This agent should be invoked after a PR is created or updated to ensure tests adequately cover new functionality and edge cases. See "When to invoke" in the agent body for worked scenarios. (Tools: All tools)

This agent should be invoked proactively after completing a logical chunk of work that involves error handling, catch blocks, fallback logic, or any code that could potentially suppress errors. 106	import fastifyJwt from '@fastify/jwt'
107	import type { FastifyReply, FastifyRequest } from 'fastify'
108	import { config } from '../config.js'
109	
110	function extractToken(req: FastifyRequest): string | null {
111	  const h = req.headers.authorization
112	  if (!h) return null
113	  const m = h.match(/^(?:Token|Bearer)\s+(.+)$/i)
114	  return m ? m[1] : null
115	}

118	  app.register(fastifyJwt, { secret: config.jwtSecret })
119	
120	  app.decorate('authenticate', async (req: FastifyRequest, reply: FastifyReply) => {
121	    const token = extractToken(req)
122	    if (!token) return reply.code(401).send({ errors: { body: ['unauthorized'] } })
123	    try {
124	      req.user = app.jwt.verify(token)
125	    } catch {
126	      return reply.code(401).send({ errors: { body: ['unauthorized'] } })
127	    }
128	  })
129

131	    const token = extractToken(req)
132	    if (!token) return
133	    try { req.user = app.jwt.verify(token) } catch { /* 무시: 익명 취급 */ }
134	  })
135	})
136	```
